composition.precedence: P1344 overrides only the P1344 whole-file hashes, the covers/body ownership of P1343-FUNC-CARRIER-HELPERS, and appends the two exact capsules in added_capsules. Any other difference from the protected base is invalid.

marker_policy.lexical: full-line Rust line comments only; never strings, raw strings, chars, block comments or reconstructed macro tokens
marker_policy.cardinality: each of the 38 listed ids exactly once; no unknown id, nesting or overlap; only the 12 allowlisted files

normalization.algorithm: Resolve this closed overlay against the protected P1343 base; validate markers, owners, exact anchors and manifest; process all 38 capsules in descending live byte offset; replace each complete begin-through-end region with its decoded exact replacement; hash each normalized complete file; require the P1344 baseline_file_sha256.
normalization.source_of_truth: protected base bytes, this overlay, decoded replacement bytes and live source only; DTO booleans, candidate ranges, aliases, declared hashes and fabricated owners are untrusted
normalization.insert_rule: decoded replacement is empty; capsule body is an exact cfg-guarded grammar production in its declared owner
normalization.replace_rule: inherited verbatim from protected P1343 base and contract; no new replace capsule exists
normalization.precedence: P1344 baseline_file_sha256 values replace P1343 whole-file hashes; inherited capsule anchors and replacement bytes remain byte-identical
